name: ai-seo-skill
description: Search-visibility instructions for Google, Maps, YouTube, app stores, and marketplaces. No invented statistics and no retired rich-result tricks.

interface.longDescription: Tells an agent how to make a page, listing, or brand findable on the search surface that matters. It separates platform rules from industry habits, skips retired rich results, and does not invent statistics.
defaultPrompt: Audit this URL for the search surfaces that matter. Say what is broken, what is fine, and what you could not check.
Which search surfaces should this business prioritize, and which should it ignore?
Rewrite this page for the searcher. Flag anything that would be keyword stuffing or a retired rich-result trick.
